title: Adaptive Probabilistic Shielding by Learning MDPs for Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic shielding is a technique for safe reinforcement learning (RL). Typically, a static observer -- called the shield -- constrains the learning agent's actions to those for which acting safely remains feasible. Traditionally, the shield is computed from the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov decision process (MDP). Thus, this technique is not applicable when the MDP model is not given a priori, which, unfortunately, is the case in typical RL applications. In this paper, we study the problem of computing a shield in the setting where the transition graph of the MDP is known, but the transition probabilities are unknown. Our approach integrates probabilistic shielding with online model learning: as the RL agent explores the environment, we estimate the transition probabilities. translated_title: 通过学习MDP实现自适应概率屏蔽以支持安全强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19836v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：概率屏蔽是一种用于安全强化学习（RL）的技术。通常，一个静态观察器——称为屏蔽器——将学习代理的动作限制为那些保持安全可行的动作。传统上，屏蔽器是根据底层马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的转移概率计算的。因此，当MDP模型未预先给定时，该技术不适用，而这在典型的RL应用中恰恰是常见情况。在本文中，我们研究了在MDP转移图已知但转移概率未知的情况下计算屏蔽器的问题。我们的方法将概率屏蔽与在线模型学习相结合：当RL代理探索环境时，我们估计转移概率。根据此估计，我们计算一个屏蔽器。虽然屏蔽器最初可能较为保守，但随着模型估计变得更加精确，它会自适应调整。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在MDP转移概率未知但转移图已知的情况下，通过在线学习估计转移概率并自适应计算概率屏蔽器的方法，从而扩展了概率屏蔽技术在安全强化学习中的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method to compute an adaptive probabilistic shield by online learning transition probabilities in settings where the MDP transition graph is known but probabilities are unknown, extending probabilistic shielding to broader safe RL applications.
